context_limit.how_to_confirm: the context_length of the pinned endpoint in the OpenRouter endpoint listing for the pinned model (GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<model>/endpoints; not a model call)
context_limit.ratified: user, 2026-10-16: when the next request won't fit, hide the oldest tool outputs, the same way in every arm, and log it; review views are built from the full record
context_limit.size_rule: prompt (o200k_base per-message measure x the provider-to-local ratio of the latest request with a provider count) + the request's response cap (max_tokens, 262,144 here) <= window_tokens; see src/trajectory_retention/execution/context_limit.py

provider_decision.rule: DigitalOcean if the smoke test passes, including published precision; otherwise StreamLake fp8 (user, 2026-10-05).
provider_decision.result: StreamLake fp8. DigitalOcean passed pin match, reasoning passback and caching and was fastest, but publishes no precision (OpenRouter lists it as unknown; its docs name the model 'DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731', which was not confirmed to be V4.1 Flash).

model_decision.rule: user, 2026-10-22: "let's just use Dsv4.1 instead of 1017 more stalls right it's a little worse" (original DeepSeek V4.1 Flash); provider back to StreamLake fp8 per provider_decision (2026-10-07)
model_decision.why: on the 1017 stage-1 screen (artifacts/v2/screen/tbv4-1017-20261021) mvcc 3/3, atrx 2/2 and production-planning 2/2 solved, nearly all on the first submission, so too few stalls

superseded.rule: user, 2026-10-21: "lets use 1017 for at least our 6 sealed task runs" (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 snapshot, released 2026-10-17); provider Parasail fp8 (Q30 pick, agreed)
superseded.why_parasail: StreamLake does not serve 1017; Morph has no tool use for 1017 (HTTP 404 'No endpoints found that support tool use'); DeepInfra caps responses at 131072 (< max_tokens 262144); DeepSeek first party is excluded by the account's training data policy; Cloudflare was rate-limited and publishes no precision. Parasail fp8 passed pin match and past-reasoning passback in the smoke test; on an 8,688-token prompt its repeats read 8,576 tokens from cache.

unresolved_retry.ratified: user, 2026-10-23 (Q55 b): retry an attempt whose generation is unresolved (HTTP 529/520/504, timeouts) instead of stopping the run; charge each such attempt its worst case against the $3 guard
unresolved_retry.why: the tbv4-v41-20261023 stage-1 screen lost 11 of 24 runs to single unresolved attempts (0.5% of 2,145 calls) under the Q8 stop
unresolved_retry.retries: within worker_request_policy max_attempts (5 attempts per call, so up to 4 retries), exponential backoff from 4 s; a call still unresolved on its last attempt stops the run as before
unresolved_retry.price_source: 2026-10-23 OpenRouter endpoint listing for streamlake/fp8: prompt $0.147/M and completion $0.588/M after a 0.51 discount, so $0.30/M and $1.20/M before it; above the price card (0.141/0.564) and every observed price
unresolved_retry.bound: worst case of one attempt = serialized request bytes x prompt price + the attempt's response cap x completion price; used by the guards only, the attempt's usage stays unknown in the ledger
